summary: This is a Form 8-K filed by Solstice Advanced Materials Inc. reporting a routine quarterly dividend declaration of $0.075 per share, not a special situation. The board declared the dividend on April 27, 2026, payable June 10, 2026, to holders of record on May 27, 2026. There are no M&A, activist, restructuring, or other special-situation elements. The filing is a standard current report on other events (Item 8.01) with no deal terms or strategic actions. As a routine capital allocation event, it falls outside the scope of special situations.
